entries.bd80dd038b001392: It has set a medium-term management plan, 'Growth, Reborn towards 2033,' aimed at its 100th anniversary in 2033, and positions fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030 as a foundation-building period toward its next 100 years. It states that it will pursue creating new business opportunities through co-creation with external partners and use of digital technology, expanding problem-solving services such as filtration systems and contract processing, and promoting overseas expansion centered on Asian markets.
